description.zh: 结束时间，用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 页码。取值范围：大于等于1。
单页显示记录的数量，取值范围：1~100。
description.en: The number of callback records to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 起始时间，用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 订阅ID。您可通过[CreateEventSub](~~2848209~~)接口的返回参数查询订阅ID。
description.en: The subscription ID. You can obtain the ID from the response to the [CreateEventSub](~~2848209~~) operation.

descriptions.zh:
- 最大查询跨度：7天。
- 最小查询粒度：1分钟。
- 最大查询范围：最近7天的数据。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
*   The maximum time range to query is seven days.
*   The minimum time granularity to query is 1 minute.
*   You can query data in the last seven days.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.
